Aroma Ingredients IN STOCK

Black Agarwood Artificial

SKU: 6WU07708

Batch Date

Black Agarwood Artificial represents the darkest grade, black or true agar notes. Woody-ambery fungal reflecting the typical odour of the black resin of agarwood with olibanum and balsamic/oriental notes. This is the type of Oud note used in Tom Ford fragrances.

Odour & Impact

The odour and uses of Black Agarwood Artificial:

Odour=> Agarwood darkest grade, black or true agar, woody-ambery fungal reflecting the typical odour of the black resin of agarwood olibanum and balsamic/oriental. Sandalwood aspects.
Perfume-Uses=> Oriental Arabian Perfumes and Mukulats, Chypre Incense Woody blends Men's Leather fragrances.

Blends-well-with=> Olibanum (Frankincense) Myrrh, Opoponax, Sandalwood, iso-Butyl Quinolene, Saffron, Wardia Rose

Relative Odor Impact 120
Odor Life (Smelling Strip) 300 hrs
